title: At the Center of Cromb Coo Coo
alt: A worried, spiky-haired man stands at the center of a rocky terrace, surrounded by floating forest islands, mountain clouds, a giant woodgrain bird, arching roots, oak leaves, acorns, a trumpet-playing turtle, and an orb-carrying figure.
description: The man from the Future GIF finds himself at the heart of Cromb Coo Coo: a vast, improbable world grown from notebook forests, strange landmarks, and familiar visitors.
